items.title: Control a Normalized Branch with a Gate
items.objective: Implement conditional_gate(x, scale, shift, gate, epsilon=1e-6). A gate of zero closes this branch even if the conditioning shift is nonzero. A constant token has zero normalized features and therefore exposes only gate*shift.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/adaln_zero.py

items.title: Share Key and Value Heads across Query Groups
items.objective: Implement grouped_attention(queries, keys, values). Different queries sharing the same keys can still produce different mixtures. Sharing a value head does not force the outputs of its query group to be identical.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/gqa.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Subtract Two Attention Maps
items.objective: Implement differential_attention(q1, k1, q2, k2, values, coefficient). Signed mixing can produce outputs outside the range of the supplied values. That is expected because the subtraction removes the convex-combination constraint.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/diff_attention.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Learn a Mixture over Graph Neighbors
items.objective: Implement graph_attention(features, adjacency, weights, attention, negative_slope=0.2). Adjacency specifies presence, not attention magnitude. A self-edge participates only when explicitly supplied.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/gat_layer.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Build Messages from Nodes and Edge Features
items.objective: Implement edge_messages(features, adjacency, edges, message_weights, update_weights). Two edges linking otherwise identical nodes can carry different messages through their edge features. A node with no incoming weight can still retain its own features through the update projection.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/mpnn_layer.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Advance a Diagonal State-Space Memory
items.objective: Implement state_space_step(x, state, decay, input_weights, output_weights, delta). Restricting decay to nonpositive values prevents exponential growth of the retained memory. The input term still depends linearly on the time step.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/mamba_ssm.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Recombine a Feedforward Layer from Shards
items.objective: Implement sharded_mlp(x, up_shards, down_shards). The elementwise activation can be evaluated independently on each hidden shard. The final sum matches multiplying the concatenated hidden features by the vertically stacked down weights.
attribution: Adapted MIT-licensed arithmetic: https://github.com/whwangovo/pyre-code/blob/7ede95b47437798c74023a0ffae8fb33bbeebc2e/torch_judge/tasks/tensor_parallel.py
Upstream copyright (c) 2024 duoan and (c) 2024 kiren. Full MIT notice retained; original additions Apache-2.0 and original prose CC-BY-SA-4.0.

items.title: Carry a Hidden State through a Sequence
items.objective: Implement recurrent_states(inputs, initial, input_weights, recurrent_weights, bias). Nonzero recurrence lets earlier inputs affect later outputs through hidden state. Reversing a sequence generally changes more than the output order.

items.title: Separate LSTM Cell Memory from Hidden Output
items.objective: Implement lstm_step(cell, input_logits, forget_logits, output_logits, candidate_logits). A closed output gate can conceal information that remains in the cell. Treating hidden output as the next cell loses this distinction.

items.title: Distinguish GRU Reset from Update Gates
items.objective: Implement gru_step(previous, update_logits, reset_logits, input_candidate, recurrent_candidate). Closing reset prevents the recurrent contribution from shaping the candidate. Update can still retain old state directly.

items.title: Keep the Identity Path during Backpropagation
items.objective: Implement residual_backward(x, weights, upstream). When all branch activations are negative, the identity path still carries upstream. Masking both routes incorrectly eliminates that gradient.

items.title: Distribute Average-Pooling Gradients
items.objective: Implement average_pool_backward(upstream, input_shape, kernel, stride). Center pixels of overlapping windows receive more contributions than corners. The pattern follows coverage rather than pixel values.

items.title: Differentiate a Spatial Cross-Correlation
items.objective: Implement convolution_backward(image, kernel, upstream). An interior pixel influences several outputs, so its derivative sums their contributions. A kernel coefficient likewise influences every valid output location.

items.title: Construct a Transposed Convolution by Scattering
items.objective: Implement transposed_convolution(signal, kernel, stride). Segments can reinforce or cancel where they overlap. Assignment instead of addition silently loses earlier contributions.

items.title: Normalize Channels in Separate Groups
items.objective: Implement group_normalize(x, groups, epsilon=1e-6). Changing the groups changes which population normalizes each feature. Batch size does not enter those statistics.

items.title: Sum the Probability of CTC Alignments
items.objective: Implement ctc_probability(probabilities, labels, blank=0). Consecutive repeated frame labels merge before blanks are removed. Thus a target with two identical labels needs a blank frame between their emissions.

items.title: Measure a Latent Gaussian against a Unit Prior
items.objective: Implement gaussian_kl(mean, log_variance). The location term penalizes squared distance from the prior mean. The uncertainty term is minimized at unit variance and grows for both very narrow and very broad distributions.

items.title: Differentiate through a Supplied Noise Draw
items.objective: Implement reparameterization_backward(mean, log_variance, noise, upstream). Holding noise fixed creates a deterministic path from distribution parameters to one sampled latent value. The derivative with respect to log variance changes sign with the noise draw.

items.title: Recover the Conditional Diffusion Posterior
items.objective: Implement diffusion_posterior(clean, noisy, beta, previous_retention). Conditioning on the clean endpoint produces a different update from a denoiser prediction. The posterior variance vanishes at the first forward step.

items.title: Separate Discriminator and Generator Objectives
items.objective: Implement adversarial_losses(real_logits, fake_logits). The discriminator pushes real scores upward and fake scores downward. The non-saturating generator objective pushes fake scores upward without changing real logits.

items.title: Compare Positive and Negative Embedding Distances
items.objective: Implement triplet_margin(anchor, positive, negative, margin=1.0). The margin compares relative distances rather than forcing positives to coincide. Once the negative is sufficiently farther away, that triplet contributes zero.

items.title: Average Log Probabilities across Positive Partners
items.objective: Implement supervised_contrastive(scores, labels). An anchor with several positives contributes the mean of their individual log losses. Taking the log of summed positive probability implements a different objective.

items.title: Measure Soft Segmentation Overlap
items.objective: Implement soft_dice_loss(probabilities, targets, smoothing=1e-6). The objective uses soft predicted mass, so it remains sensitive to confidence without a hard threshold. A perfectly matched binary mask has zero loss.

items.title: Differentiate an Image Smoothness Penalty
items.objective: Implement total_variation(image). An interior pixel receives derivative contributions from several neighboring differences. Equal neighbors use the stated zero subgradient at the absolute-value kink.

items.title: Apply a Softmax Jacobian without Building It
items.objective: Implement softmax_jvp(probabilities, direction). The Jacobian is diag(p)-p*p.T. Distributing its product gives an elementwise expression with one weighted reduction per row.

items.title: Estimate a Matrix Trace with Sign Probes
items.objective: Implement trace_probes(matrix, probes). Independent balanced sign probes have identity second moment, making the quadratic estimate unbiased over that random distribution. Fixed probes are supplied here to expose individual errors.

items.title: Trace Gradients through Attention Scores and Values
items.objective: Implement attention_backward(queries, keys, values, upstream). A single-key attention output cannot depend on query or key scores, so their gradients vanish while the value still receives upstream.

items.title: Normalize Scores over Every Label Sequence
items.objective: Implement chain_log_partition(emissions, transitions, start, end). The log partition includes all paths, even those with poor scores. Replacing log-sum-exp with max computes a best-path score and loses normalization mass.

items.title: Recover the Best Label Sequence with Backtracking
items.objective: Implement chain_viterbi(emissions, transitions, start, end). A temporarily worse prefix may become the best complete sequence through a favorable transition. Keeping one state for each ending label preserves those possibilities.

items.title: Trace Returns across Episode Boundaries
items.objective: Compute reward-to-go at every transition. Change one terminal flag and predict which earlier returns change before running the examples.
attribution: Original lesson, code, and test fixtures. Conceptual reading only; no source code or prose copied: https://spinningup.openai.com/en/latest/spinningup/rl_intro3.html

items.title: Combine Temporal-Difference Residuals with GAE
items.objective: Return GAE advantages and corresponding value targets. Compare trace decay zero and one to see how much future evidence enters each estimate.

items.title: Turn Uniform Draws into a Categorical Choice
items.objective: Use the supplied uniform draws to perturb logits. Compare a deterministic preference with a noise-driven change of action.

items.title: Move a Target Network Gradually
